text: Implemented typed executable VolumeSamples/SurfaceVertices payloads with content fingerprints and geometry validation; standard volume-to-surface and surface-to-surface pullback compilers; mixed compiler walking selected final surface vertices backward through surface maps, one sampling bridge, and affine/warp prefix into one root CSR; legacy V2S compiler now accepts surrounding transforms. Cross-platform fixtures cover affine-ribbon-surface, nonlinear-surface, surface-root mapping, exact support and mismatches. git diff --check clean; spatialJVM 97/97; spatialJS 87/87.
